svg.title: DUET method: one training step
svg.desc: Animated schematic. (i) Allocate: each prompt gets an informativeness score and a cost; the cost-weighted Neyman rule n_q = s_q / sqrt(lambda* L_q) sets its rollout count under the token budget. (ii) Generate: rollouts that emit an answer marker after K1 are trimmed shortly after it; marker-less rollouts past K2+G are aborted and masked, except an epsilon fraction kept to EOS with weight 1/epsilon. (iii) Update: importance-corrected backward on kept rollouts; online statistics feed the next step. A single dual variable lambda* couples allocation and generation.
svg.text: scarce tokens → λ* ↑ → fewer rollouts · plentiful → λ* ↓
Σ nq L̂q = B, solved by bisection on λ*
Marker polled every 8 tokens from K₁ · K₁, K₂ = online p30 / p80 of recent kept lengths
marker-less rollouts: abort w.p. 1−ε, else keep with weight 1/ε (unbiased)
online state for the next step: ŝq ← running std(A · log π), L̂q, K₁ / K₂
